title: Display Canister IDs and Unified Architecture Information on Banco Central Page

requirements.text: Display Principal ID, internal UserID, and all active canister IDs with their functions on the Banco Central page. Show the following canisters with their descriptions: crjop-jyaaa-aaaah-atfaq-cai (Frontend/UI - page and interface control), ckmsk-taaaa-aaaah-atfca-cai (Game Logic/Profile/Progression - XP, QMY/ICP coins, captured monsters), nemlr-6aaaa-aaaan-q32la-cai (Governance/Treasury - bonus and rewards distribution), ippxc-5iaaa-aaaae-qgwqq-cai (Main Profile/Unified UserID - real site ↔ app synchronization), x5shd-hqaaa-aaaap-qrdgq-cai (DAO/Game Data Warehouse - transaction history, player actions), i7nyb-2yaaa-aaaaj-qowiq-cai (Bridge/Integration - communication between additional canisters), lkawl-3qaaa-aaaac-qdsoq-cai (Extra Canister/Supplementary Game Data). Present this information in a clear, organized, and readable format.

quotes: Mostrar de forma clara e discriminada: Principal ID, UserID interno, Todos os canisters ativos com suas funções detalhadas
A página Banco Central deve exibir claramente: Principal ID, UserID Interno, Todos os canisters ativos e suas funções

acceptanceCriteria: Banco Central page displays the authenticated user's Principal ID
Banco Central page displays the internal UserID
All seven canister IDs are listed with their corresponding functions
Information is presented in a legible and organized format
No changes to existing page layout, footers, or visual styling

requirements.text: Ensure all profile data, progression, coins, and bonuses are accessible via the unified canister architecture listed in REQ-1. Confirm that no data depends on separate Principals and that the system uses the internal UserID for data storage and retrieval across all canisters.

quotes: Todos os dados de perfil, progresso, moedas e bónus devem ser acessíveis via esses canisters unificados. Nenhum dado deve depender de Principals separados.
Garantir que todas as ações e bónus continuem funcionando normalmente

acceptanceCriteria: Profile data queries use internal UserID as the primary key
Progression data (XP, level, energy) is retrieved using internal UserID
Coin balances (available, planted, bonus) are stored and accessed via internal UserID
All bonus distributions and actions continue to function normally
No data operations rely on Principal as the primary identifier

constraints: Do not alter the existing layout, footers, or pages of the site
Do not modify the visual design or styling of the Banco Central page
Maintain all existing functionality for actions and bonuses
nonGoals: Implementing new features beyond canister visibility
Changing the authentication flow or Internet Identity integration
Creating new backend endpoints not related to canister information retrieval
